projects.title: High-Throughput Payment Processing Platform
projects.description: Design and implement a production-grade payment gateway capable of 50,000 TPS with idempotency, exactly-once semantics, and sub-100ms P99 authorisation latency.
objectives: Design a horizontally scalable payment authorisation pipeline
Implement idempotency with distributed deduplication
Apply CompletableFuture-based parallel enrichment (fraud, FX, balance)
Handle exactly-once Kafka event publishing via Outbox pattern
Achieve P99 < 100ms under 50k TPS sustained load

projects.title: Concurrent Double-Entry Ledger Engine
projects.description: Build a concurrent, ACID-compliant double-entry ledger that handles 10,000 concurrent balance updates with no race conditions, guaranteed accounting invariants, and full audit trail.
objectives: Implement double-entry accounting with database-enforced invariants
Prevent race conditions using optimistic and pessimistic locking strategies
Design a tamper-evident hash-chained audit log
Handle the concurrent overdraft problem correctly
Achieve linearisable balance updates at 10k concurrent writers

projects.title: Distributed AML & Sanctions Screening Platform
projects.description: Build a real-time AML transaction monitoring system with Kafka Streams windowed aggregation, sanctions screening, alert generation, and regulatory audit trail.
objectives: Implement Kafka Streams windowed aggregation for structuring detection
Design a rule engine with pluggable AML scenarios
Build a sanctions screening service with fuzzy name matching
Create a tamper-evident compliance audit trail
Handle regulatory latency requirements (sub-500ms screening)

projects.title: Financial Reconciliation Engine
projects.description: Design a financial reconciliation system that detects discrepancies between internal ledger records and external settlement reports, with automated break investigation and resolution workflows.
objectives: Design a multi-source reconciliation pipeline with CDC (Debezium)
Implement break detection with configurable tolerance rules
Build an event-sourced break investigation workflow
Handle settlement file formats (BACS, SWIFT MT940)
Provide real-time reconciliation dashboards via CQRS projections

projects.title: Multi-Region Banking Platform
projects.description: Architect a multi-region active-active banking platform with conflict-free data replication, region-local reads, global consistency for critical operations, and sub-50ms RTO.
objectives: Design active-active multi-region topology with conflict resolution
Implement CRDTs for balance accumulators across regions
Apply global CP for critical operations, regional AP for reads
Design the cross-region Saga for international transfers
Achieve RTO < 50ms and RPO = 0 for account balance data

projects.title: Production Observability & Incident Investigation Platform
projects.description: Build a production-grade observability stack for a payment platform: OpenTelemetry instrumentation, SLO-based alerting, distributed trace correlation, JVM diagnostics, and a runbook-driven incident response framework.
objectives: Instrument a payment service with OpenTelemetry traces, metrics, and logs
Define SLIs, SLOs, and configure multi-window burn-rate alerts
Build a trace-to-log correlation dashboard in Grafana
Design the on-call runbook for a P1 payment processing incident
Implement JVM flight recorder profiling for production use
